questions.question:
What will be the output of the follow Python statement?
print("diploma"[2:-1])
questions.explanation: String slicing [2:-1] starts from index 2 ('p') to second last character ('m'), giving 'plom'. Wait, checking again: d(0)i(1)p(2)l(3)o(4)m(5)a(6), [2:-1] gives indices 2,3,4,5 = 'plom'.

questions.question: Which one of the following is known as membership operator?
